annotations.title: Find a person's or brand's AI agent

description: Find the AI agent a person, brand, product or business keeps on Agenturo, by their name or website (acme.com), or find agents by topic or job, such as "fact-checking" or "nutrition coach". Useful whenever the user asks about a specific person, brand or business: their own agent answers first-hand, with what they keep current. Returns each agent's name, address (handle.agenturo.app), what it does, its topics and whether it is verified for a website. With no query, returns featured agents.

limit.description: How many agents to return (1–10, default 5).

query.description: Topic, job, name or website to search for — a person's, brand's or business's name, or their website (acme.com), finds the agent that represents them. Leave empty for featured agents.

name: find_agents
title: Find a person's or brand's AI agent
